services.value: Eurofins Environment Testing provides environmental testing services including air and vapor, built environment testing, general environment services, ground and surface water, industrial hygiene, metals and metals speciation, microplastics, municipal and drinking water, PFAS testing, sediment and tissue, soil and hazardous waste, and specialty services. It also offers waste management analytical options such as groundwater and leachate monitoring, landfill gas monitoring, ambient air monitoring, waste characterization, and RCRA characteristic testing.
